learning_outcomes.text: Analyzes two- or three-dimensional systems under the influence of forces or moments
Learns the basic concepts and principles of statics and be able to use them in solving problems.
Calculates center of gravity, moment of inertia, and resultant forces
Calculates support reactions in structural systems
Analyzes structural systems such as trusses, beams and cables and draw their internal force diagrams

syllabus_topics: Mechanics, scalar and vector quantities, Newton’s Laws, units, Law of gravitation, description of statics problems.
Centroids of areas, lines and volumes
